verdict.rationale: Brex has a Travel product referenced by community praise ('Brex Travel was luxurious') and API evidence shows bookings carry a policy object flagging out-of-policy violations at booking time, indicating in-platform policy enforcement rather than post-hoc expensing. However, there is no first-party documentation describing the actual booking flow, flight/hotel inventory, or how policy is applied at the point of booking beyond the changelog note. missing for 10: dedicated travel booking product docs, details on flight/hotel search and booking UX, and independent confirmation of policy enforcement blocking non-compliant bookings.
